name: Yoohee

skills.name: Rhythmic Pulse
skills.description: Selects an enemy target within a 8 tile radius and deals Physical damage equivalent to 80% ATK to it

skills.name: Improv
skills.description: Selects an enemy target within a 8 tile radius and deals Physical damage equivalent to 120% ATK to it. If Yoohee has 3 or more points of Confectance Index, consumes 2 additional points of Confectance Index to ignore 30% of the target's defense on this attack

skills.name: Soul of Dance
skills.description:
Selects an ally within a 8 tile radius, and applies Targeted Attack Defense I to it and all allies within a 2 tile radius of the selected ally for 2 turns.

Deals AoE Physical damage equal to 80% ATK to all enemies within range, and applies Stun for 1 turn. After the attack, Yoohee gains 1 use of active skill Graceful Piroulette or Passionate Resonance.

skills.name: Sparkling Finale
skills.description: Yoohee gains Troupe's Core for 3 turns. Applies Stability Offensive I for all allies for 2 turns. After skill usage, gains Extra Command.

skills.name: Main Dancer's Aura
skills.description:
When allies deal Physical damage, Yoohee gains 1 point of Confectance Index.

After using basic attack or active skills, Graceful Pirouette or Passionate Resonance can be used (this effect cannot be triggered repeatedly).

For 3 or more Dance Steps applies, triggers an instance of Best Dancer, and gains 1 stack of Never Give Up, and refreshes the duration of all Dance Steps and Reversed Assault stacks across the entire battlefield.

skills.name: Graceful Pirouette
skills.description: Selects an ally (excluding self) within a 8 tile radius, and applies Graceful Spin and Reversed Assault for 3 turns.

skills.name: Passionate Resonance
skills.description: Selects an ally (excluding self) within a 8 tile radius, and applies Passionate Spin and Reversed Assault for 3 turns.

fortification.effect:
Stability Offensive II is applied instead of Stability Offensive I. Additionally applies Attack Up II for all allied units for 2 turns

After skill usage, if Graceful Pirouette or Passionate Resonance is used on this turn, the effects are applied to all allies

The selection range of Graceful Pirouette and Passionate Resonance is expanded to the entire field

New effect is added for Graceful Pirouette- Restores HP equivalent to 15% max HP

New effect is added for Passionate Resonance - Cleanses 1 debuff from the target

When Best Dancer is triggered, applies Defense Down II for the enemy with the highest initial DEF for 3 turns. if Yoohee has Troupe's Core, Never Give Up decreases damage taken by allies by 30%

Yoohee gains 1 stack of Never Give Up

New effect is added for Troupe's Core - When attacking, ignores 50% of the enemy's DEF. After triggering the effects of Best Dancer, immediately activates Improv on the enemy with the highest current HP within range. This effect can only trigger once per round, and Graceful Pirouette and Passionate Resonance cannot be used after that instance of the skill 

For every 2 times Best Dancer is triggered, reduces the cooldown of this skill by 1 turn
Increases the damage multiplier by 60%. For each Dance Steps applied, gains 1 stack of Fantastic Conception

Increases the damage multiplier by 50%, and increases the effect range by 1 tile

Targeted Attack Defense II is applied instead of Targeted Attack Defense I. Cleanses Taunt, Fear, Stun, and Infatuated for all allies

Doubles the effects of Dance Steps for self (Increases CRIT DMG by 20%, recovers HP equivalent to 40% ATK, gains 3 stacks of Shelter)

For each buff applies to other allies, increases ATK by 1.5% for self, up to a maximum of 45%. When triggering Best Dancer, applies Preshow Warmup for all allies for 2 turns

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Effort and Returns
keys.effect: Improv: When additional points of Confectance Index is consumed, increases CRIT DMG dealt by 5%

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Enjoy The Limelight
keys.effect: Best Dancer: When this effect is triggered, restores HP equivalent to 20% max HP

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Tempo Resonance
keys.effect: Improv: Before skill usage, dispels 1 random buff from the target

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Infectious Emotions
keys.effect: Soul of Dance: After this skill applies Stun on the enemy, when Stun is removed, applies Movement Denied for 1 turn

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Marvellous Shift
keys.effect: If Yoohee did not move on this turn, increases attack range of basic attack and skills by 3 tiles on the next turn

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Exquisite Choreography
keys.effect: Never Give Up: When this effect is active, increases ATK by 10%

keys.name: Common Key - Main Dancer's Might
keys.effect: ATK +5% / When dealing Ammo-type damage, increases damage dealt by 10%

keys.name: Expansion Key - Flawless Dance Moves
keys.effect:
After using Sparkling Finale, when using Graceful Pirouette or Passionate Resonance, the skill will also trigger on 2 allies with the highest ATK that were not selected by the skill (excluding self). These 2 skills can no longer be used on the current turn

When dealing Physical damage from a passive skill, triggers the effects of Never Give Up. Its effects will no longer be nullified if allies dealt Phase damage

Increases healing received by allies by 50%. At the start of the battle, for each Physical attribute ally on the field, increases Physical damage dealt by allies by 3%, up to a maximum of 15%

source_notes: Extracted from GFL2 Official Release Info Compilation.xlsx with online Dandegate/gfl2.help enrichment.
